rendered.subject: Celebrating Your Mission
rendered.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that highlights your commitment to quality and producer relationships. As your business continues to grow and evolve, your Direct Trade model will continue to be a cornerstone of your mission of making the most positive impact where you can. [P6] We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers. Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement. This post would be a great way to share your dedication to quality and the impact of your producers, while also reinforcing your commitment to the Stumptown Coffee Roasters experience. The post would be a way to celebrate what F1 describes, created together with your team.

The BrandPilot team
